records.example_en: Please put away sharp tools after using them.
records.example_zh: 用完锋利工具后请妥善收好。
records.usage_note: put away表示放回安全的收纳位置，不等于扔掉。
records.linguistic_reason: sharp tools可表示带锋利刃口或尖端的工具；中文“尖锐工具”偏向尖端而未覆盖刀刃锋利的器具。例句中文“锋利工具”反而更准确。
records.suggested_fix: source gloss建议“锋利或尖锐的工具”，待Master批准。

records.example_en: Please pick up the clothes you left on the floor.
records.example_zh: 请把你扔在地板上的衣服捡起来。
collocations: pick clothes up off the floor
records.usage_note: pick up强调从地上或表面捡起，后续还可能需要折叠收纳。
records.linguistic_reason: you left on the floor是放／留在地上的衣服；“你扔在地板上”暗示故意丢弃，中文语义增加未明示的动作意图。
records.suggested_fix: 中文例句改“请把你留在地板上的衣服捡起来”。

records.example_en: I keep my glasses on the nightstand.
records.example_zh: 我把眼镜放在床头柜上。
records.usage_note: nightstand是美式常用的床头柜说法，英式也可说bedside table。
records.linguistic_reason: bedside nightstand略重复但美国英语真实可用，nightstand drawer更常见；主要例句地道，冗余不足以构成教学错误。

records.example_en: I found a sock in the corner of the room.
records.example_zh: 我在房间角落找到了一只袜子。
records.usage_note: corner在这里指室内角落，不是街角。
records.linguistic_reason: in the corner of the room例句正确；room corner不如corner of the room自然，属于搭配范例优化而非核心Sense错误。
records.suggested_fix: 第二搭配换a corner of the room或in the corner of the room。

records.example_en: The room has stale air because the windows have been closed.
records.example_zh: 窗户一直关着，房间里的空气很闷。
records.usage_note: stale air指不新鲜、缺乏流通的空气。
records.linguistic_reason: The room has stale air语法和实际使用可接受；虽然The air in the room is stale更简洁自然，但不应机械把一种自然风格判错。

records.expression: put dirty clothes in the hamper
records.example_en: Put dirty clothes in the hamper instead of on the floor.
records.example_zh: 把脏衣服放进脏衣篮，别扔地上。
collocations: put dirty clothes in the hamper
records.usage_note: hamper在北美居家语境常指脏衣篮。
records.linguistic_reason: put dirty clothes in the hamper instead of on the floor符合日常训诫；中文“别扔地上”属于可接受的语用转述，不必机械读作确定曾经故意扔。

records.example_en: I tucked the loose cable behind the desk.
records.example_zh: 我把散落的电线收到了书桌后面。
records.usage_note: loose在此指没有固定好的线缆，不一定已经损坏。
records.linguistic_reason: loose cable主要表示松脱、未固定的线缆，中文“散落的电线”暗示散放状态；源usage_note已正确解释未固定。
records.suggested_fix: gloss改“松脱的／未固定好的线缆”，译文可写“我把松散的线缆收到桌后”，待Master核准gloss。

records.example_en: I untangled the cables behind my computer.
records.example_zh: 我把电脑后面缠在一起的线理开了。
records.usage_note: tangled强调缠绕打结，不等于线缆本身断裂。
records.mu_qa_reason: 英文例句 'I untangled the cables behind my computer.' 中没有出现目标表达 'tangled cables'（只出现 cables，tangled 被替换为动词 untangled），违反例句须出现目标表达原形的要求。
records.linguistic_reason: I untangled the cables behind my computer自然且语义上预设线缆缠绕，但目标形容词tangled没出现，学习者不易学到其表语或定语搭配；此前建议untangle tangled cables又存在不必要词根重复。
records.suggested_fix: 例句改“The cables behind my computer were tangled, so I separated them.” 或自然的“The cables behind my computer got tangled.”

records.sense_zh: 霉菌；霉斑（常见于潮湿表面）
records.example_en: There are mildew spots on the bathroom curtain.
records.example_zh: 浴室窗帘上有些霉斑。
records.usage_note: mildew常用于描述潮湿表面或织物上的霉斑，与mold意义重叠。
records.linguistic_reason: bathroom curtain既可指浴室窗帘，也可在某些语境指浴帘；虽shower curtain更典型，原文并非明显不自然或语义错误。

records.sense_zh: 放在儿童够不到的地方
records.example_en: Keep cleaning chemicals away from children.
records.example_zh: 把清洁化学用品放在儿童接触不到的地方。
collocations: keep cleaning products away from children
records.usage_note: keep away from children是安全提醒；通常还应妥善上锁保管危险物品。
records.linguistic_reason: Keep cleaning chemicals away from children用于产品安全警示，中文“放在儿童接触不到的地方”是合理的实际执行含义，未造成实质错误。

records.sense_zh: 将不同清洁用品分开存放（勿随意混合）
records.example_en: Keep cleaning products separate, and never mix them casually.
records.example_zh: 不同清洁用品要分开存放，不要随意混合。
records.usage_note: separate在此是分开存放，切勿把清洁剂混合使用。
records.linguistic_reason: never mix them casually语法正确但作为清洁剂安全指令模糊，casually暗示谨慎时可以自行混合；应避免误导，直接用never mix cleaning products。
records.suggested_fix: 改“Keep cleaning products separate, and never mix different cleaners.”

records.example_en: We found a pest in the pantry and checked the food storage.
records.example_zh: 我们在食品储藏柜发现了一只害虫，便检查了食品存放情况。
records.usage_note: pest指令人困扰或有害的虫兽；此源项标记OPTIONAL。
records.mu_qa_reason: 用法说明末尾 '此源项标记OPTIONAL。' 是内部审校备注，不是面向学习者的内容，且该备注同时出现在 display.x 中，违反用法说明不得混入内部备注的要求；其余内容忠实于源义。
records.linguistic_reason: 目标pest可以泛指害虫害兽，例句发现食品储藏处害虫可接受；usage_note末尾‘此源项标记OPTIONAL’是内部审核状态，不属于教学语言内容。
records.suggested_fix: 删除学习者可见内部OPTIONAL标记，若需专业词义可写“pest可指害虫或其他有害动物”，资格在metadata管理。

records.example_en: We use a chore chart to divide tasks among the family.
records.example_zh: 我们用家务分工表给家庭成员分配任务。
records.usage_note: chore chart用于记录由谁承担哪些家务，chart在这里是表格。
records.linguistic_reason: divide tasks among the family为可理解且符合家务语境的英语；among family members更具体，却不意味着原句有教学错误。

records.example_en: I try to clean as I go when cooking.
records.example_zh: 做饭时我尽量边做边收拾。
collocations: clean as you go in the kitchen
records.usage_note: clean as you go指进行活动时及时清理；此项为源增补候选，仍待独立审查。
records.mu_qa_reason: 用法说明 'clean as you go指进行活动时及时清理；此项为源增补候选，仍待独立审查。' 后半句是内部审校备注（源增补候选、待独立审查），不是面向学习者的内容，且 display.x 与之一致，学习端也会看到这句内部备注。
records.linguistic_reason: clean as I go是自然人称变体，不能因此扣分；但usage_note含源增补候选及独立审查的内部状态，属于学习者可见污染。
records.suggested_fix: 删除内部状态备注，保留“clean as you go指边做事边随手清理”；搭配可选更自然clean as you cook。

records.example_en: The kitchen needs deep cleaning before the holidays.
records.example_zh: 节日前厨房需要彻底清洁一次。
records.usage_note: deep cleaning指比日常表面清洁更全面的清洁。
records.linguistic_reason: The kitchen needs deep cleaning自然可接受，deep cleaning the kitchen为名词化/动名词结构也正确；不必强制needs a deep clean。

records.example_en: I hang out the laundry when the weather is dry.
records.example_zh: 天气干燥时我把洗好的衣服挂出去晾。
records.usage_note: hang out the laundry指挂到室外或晾衣处晾干；hang out还有社交义。
records.linguistic_reason: hang out the laundry是自然表达，out常示意屋外晾晒，源注释保留室外或晾衣处，中文“挂出去晾”足够准确。

records.example_en: I spread the shirts over the drying rack.
records.example_zh: 我把衬衫摊挂在晾衣架上。
collocations: hang clothes on a drying rack
records.usage_note: drying rack是晾衣架，不是烘干机。
records.linguistic_reason: spread shirts over a drying rack适合把衣物摊开或搭在架上晾干，不必总说hang shirts；原例句在真实操作中成立。

records.example_en: The room was fresh-smelling after we opened the windows.
records.example_zh: 打开窗户后，房间闻起来很清新。
records.usage_note: fresh-smelling描述气味清新，不等于已去除所有污染源。
records.linguistic_reason: The room was fresh-smelling为可理解的形容词表语但在日常对话不如The room smelled fresh自然；作为口语教学范例建议优化，不判严重错误。
records.suggested_fix: 若要保留fresh-smelling词形，例句改“We opened the windows and enjoyed the fresh-smelling room.”，更自然可用The room smelled fresh作辨析。

records.example_en: Cleaning the oven is long overdue.
records.example_zh: 烤箱早就该清洁了，一直拖到现在。
records.usage_note: overdue表示超过应做的时间，不是日常意义上的迟到。
records.linguistic_reason: overdue cleaning与long overdue均可使用；Cleaning the oven is long overdue为高质量自然例句，不能仅凭某搭配较少见判非PASS。

records.example_en: I sort the laundry before starting the washing machine.
records.example_zh: 开洗衣机前我先给脏衣服分类。
records.usage_note: sort the laundry指将待洗衣物按颜色、材质等分类。
records.linguistic_reason: sort the laundry可针对待洗衣物也可用于洗后归类，中文gloss“分类脏衣服”将义项限于脏衣服。虽然原例句洗前场景支持，但词义释义应保留广度。
records.suggested_fix: gloss改“把衣物分类／把待洗衣物分类”，Master审批。

records.example_en: Please put dishes away after they are dry.
records.example_zh: 碗碟干了之后请放回橱柜。
records.usage_note: put away强调收回指定位置，与单纯从桌上移开不同。
records.linguistic_reason: put dishes away指将碗碟放到其存放位置，不必然是橱柜；原中文gloss添具体目的地，例句英语无此限制。
records.suggested_fix: gloss改“收起碗碟；把碗碟放回原位”，译文相应修改，Master审批gloss。

records.example_en: I change the air filter according to the manufacturer's schedule.
records.example_zh: 我按厂家的建议周期更换空气滤芯。
records.usage_note: air filter是空气过滤器滤芯，换新前应遵循设备说明。
records.linguistic_reason: air filter可指过滤器组件、滤网或滤芯，source gloss只写“滤芯”过窄；实际许多设备更换滤芯但并非英语必然义。
records.suggested_fix: gloss改“更换空气过滤器／滤网（滤芯）”，依Master确认适用Sense。

records.example_en: This blouse has delicate fabric, so follow its care label.
records.example_zh: 这件女式衬衫的面料很娇贵，洗护要看标签。
records.usage_note: delicate fabric易在粗暴洗涤中受损。
records.linguistic_reason: This blouse has delicate fabric可理解但不符合高频日常自然措辞；主语衣服与面料关系通常用is made of。
records.suggested_fix: 英文例句改“This blouse is made of delicate fabric, so follow its care label.”

records.example_en: Open the windows if cleaning fumes build up, and leave the area if needed.
records.example_zh: 如果清洁剂气体积聚，就开窗通风，必要时离开现场。
records.usage_note: cleaning fumes指挥发性气体或刺激性气味；出现不适应停止接触。
records.linguistic_reason: cleaning fumes可指清洁产品释放的刺激性蒸气／烟雾／挥发性物质，中文仅“挥发气体”略窄；例句提到远离暴露是正确安全提示。
records.suggested_fix: gloss改“清洁剂产生的刺激性蒸气或气体”，Master审批；例句保留。

records.sense_zh: 对宠物相对安全的清洁剂
records.example_en: Choose a pet-safe cleaner and follow its instructions carefully.
records.example_zh: 选择对宠物相对安全的清洁剂，并认真按说明使用。
records.usage_note: pet-safe并不保证绝对无风险，仍须避免宠物接触未干表面。
records.linguistic_reason: pet-safe cleaner说明相对安全而非无风险，作者已明确按说明及避免未干表面接触，英语自然且风险限定适当。

records.example_en: I used a stain remover to remove a stain from my shirt.
records.example_zh: 我用去渍剂去掉了衬衫上的污渍。
records.usage_note: remove a stain指去除污渍，须遵照面料洗护要求。
records.linguistic_reason: a stain remover to remove a stain为正常重复以明确物品与动作，虽可写得更简练但不是教学意义错误；搭配remove stubborn stain准确。

records.example_en: I asked a technician to fix an appliance.
records.example_zh: 我请技术人员修理一台家电。
records.usage_note: fix an appliance指修理家用电器，注意电气安全。
records.linguistic_reason: I asked a technician to fix an appliance语法、义项正确，但an appliance泛指任意家电，整句略显没有具体交流动机；作为教学范例可加强。
records.suggested_fix: 例句改“I asked a technician to fix our washing machine.” 或“I asked a technician to fix a broken appliance.”

records.example_en: This laundry load is too large for the machine.
records.example_zh: 这一批衣服太多，洗衣机装不下。
records.usage_note: laundry load指一次洗涤的衣物量。
records.linguistic_reason: This laundry load is too large for the machine是英语中可接受的名词修饰结构，尤其在洗衣设备语境；不能仅因load of laundry更常见判错。

records.example_en: I put the delicate socks in a mesh laundry bag.
records.example_zh: 我把娇贵的袜子装进洗衣网袋。
records.usage_note: mesh laundry bag能减少衣物摩擦和勾挂。
records.linguistic_reason: delicate socks可能是羊毛或其他精细袜子，用网袋洗护合理；无需假设普通袜子全部需网袋，例句没有作该主张。

records.example_en: The drying time is longer on humid days.
records.example_zh: 潮湿天气衣服晾干所需时间更长。
records.usage_note: drying time是晾干或烘干所需的时间。
records.linguistic_reason: drying time既涵盖自然晾干时间也涵盖机器烘干时间，源gloss只写“晾干所需时间”偏窄，usage_note已承认两者。
records.suggested_fix: gloss改“干燥所需时间；晾干或烘干时间”，待Master确认。

records.example_en: I put the delicates in a mesh laundry bag.
records.example_zh: 我把精细衣物装进洗衣网袋。
records.usage_note: delicates是需要轻柔护理的衣物，常用复数。
records.linguistic_reason: bag for delicates为英语可理解且自然的名词短语，虽然wash delicates in a mesh bag更清晰，原有wash delicates也符合搭配要求。

records.example_en: This sweater is made of wool and needs gentle care.
records.example_zh: 这件毛衣是羊毛的，需要轻柔护理。
records.usage_note: wool在这里指羊毛材质，通常不可数。
records.linguistic_reason: wool在例句是不可数材料名词“羊毛”，而gloss“羊毛衣物或材质”把转喻产品义混入源Sense，可能导致词性理解不稳。
records.suggested_fix: gloss建议“羊毛；羊毛面料”，衣物意义单列为用法引申，Master审批。

records.example_en: I prefer cotton towels because they absorb water well.
records.example_zh: 我更喜欢棉毛巾，因为它们吸水性好。
records.usage_note: cotton表示棉或棉质面料，在材质义上通常不可数。
records.linguistic_reason: cotton核心指棉纤维／棉布，作定语cotton towels；直接释为“棉质衣物或材质”混淆材料与成品。
records.suggested_fix: gloss改“棉；棉布（棉质面料）”，衣物作语境引申，Master审批。

records.example_en: Zip up the jacket before putting it in the wash if the label advises it.
records.example_zh: 如果洗护说明建议，洗前先拉好外套拉链。
records.usage_note: zipper是拉链，美式常用；英式也可说zip。
records.mu_qa_reason: 英文例句 'Zip up the jacket before putting it in the wash if the label advises it.' 只出现动词短语 zip up，未出现目标名词 zipper，例句与本条词形脱节。
records.linguistic_reason: 目标名词zipper为拉链，但例句只有动词短语Zip up，没有名词zipper；不同于动词词形变化，词头本身未在例句直接体现，应更精准展现名词搭配。
records.suggested_fix: 例句改“Close the jacket zipper before washing it, if the care label recommends it.”，更自然“Make sure the jacket's zipper is closed before washing it, if the care label recommends it.”

records.example_en: Fasten buttons before washing if the care instructions call for it.
records.example_zh: 如果洗护说明要求，洗衣前扣好纽扣。
records.usage_note: fasten buttons指扣好扣子，具体做法依衣物标签。
records.linguistic_reason: Fasten buttons before washing if the care instructions call for it自然且带有明确洗护标签条件，不构成普遍性不安全建议。

records.example_en: Hang up a shirt on a hanger after washing it.
records.example_zh: 洗好衬衫后把它挂到衣架上。
collocations: hang a shirt on a hanger
records.usage_note: hang up表示挂起来。
records.linguistic_reason: Hang up a shirt on a hanger为可以自然说出的完整动作指导；up/on a hanger轻度信息重叠不构成语义错误。

records.example_en: Put clothes away after folding them.
records.example_zh: 叠好后把衣服放回衣柜。
records.usage_note: put away表示归位收纳。
records.linguistic_reason: Put clothes away after folding them没指定橱柜；中文“放回衣柜”增加了未在英文例句出现的具体归位处。
records.suggested_fix: 中文译文改“衣服叠好后就收起来”；原英语无需改。

records.example_en: Shake out wrinkles before hanging the shirt.
records.example_zh: 挂衬衫前抖一抖，减少褶皱。
records.usage_note: shake out指通过抖动舒展褶皱。
records.linguistic_reason: shake out wrinkles是不加冠词的可用食谱式／洗衣指令结构，shake wrinkles out of clothes也自然，不必机械要求the。

records.example_en: The neckline is stretched out from hanging.
records.example_zh: 领口悬挂后被拉松变形了。
records.usage_note: stretched out指拉长松弛。
records.linguistic_reason: stretched-out neckline为自然带连字符的前置修饰，第二搭配stretched out clothes缺少形容词前置连字符而稍含混。
records.suggested_fix: 第二搭配改“stretched-out clothes”或“clothes that are stretched out”。

records.sense_zh: 衣物染料串色；掉色染到其他衣物
records.example_en: The red socks caused color bleeding onto my white shirt.
records.example_zh: 红袜子掉色，把我的白衬衫染上了颜色。
records.usage_note: color bleeding指染料在洗涤时转移到其他衣物，区别于单纯褪色。
records.linguistic_reason: caused color bleeding onto my white shirt意思明确但搭配显笨拙，强调污渍现象可说The red socks bled dye onto my white shirt。
records.suggested_fix: 若需保留目标表达color bleeding，可改“There was some color bleeding in the wash, and my white shirt turned pink.”

records.example_en: The label says this sweater is hand-wash only.
records.example_zh: 标签注明这件毛衣只能手洗。
records.usage_note: hand-wash only是洗护限制，不能按普通机洗程序处理。
records.linguistic_reason: hand-wash only作为形容词短语可用；在名词label前作复合定语更宜hand-wash-only label，原无连字符搭配略不规范。
records.suggested_fix: 第二搭配改“hand-wash-only label”；原例句The label says ... is hand-wash only成立。

records.sense_zh: 已经渗入织物的旧污渍
records.example_en: This old set-in stain may be difficult to remove.
records.example_zh: 这块渗进面料的旧污渍可能很难去除。
records.usage_note: set-in stain通常指已附着较久、深入纤维的污渍。
records.linguistic_reason: set-in stain指已固定、难以除去的污渍，不必然既古老又深深渗透；原gloss‘旧／渗入’两重附加条件不宜当作义项核心。
records.suggested_fix: gloss改“顽固的、已经固定的污渍”，Master审批；例句旧污渍为具体情境可保留。

records.example_en: The washer reported a spin failure at the end of the cycle.
records.example_zh: 洗涤结束时洗衣机提示脱水故障。
records.usage_note: spin failure指设备无法正常甩干，具体原因需检查。
records.linguistic_reason: washer reported a spin failure是可接受设备诊断或报错叙述，作者未声称某品牌固定故障码；英语在技术家电语境可用。

records.example_en: I use a color catcher when washing mixed-color items as directed.
records.example_zh: 按产品说明混洗不同颜色衣物时，我会用吸色片。
records.usage_note: color catcher是吸附游离染料的洗衣用品，不能保证完全防止串色。
records.linguistic_reason: 句尾as directed既可修饰使用吸色片也可修饰混洗衣物，语义指向不够明确；英语母语可懂但教学需消歧。
records.suggested_fix: 改“I follow the package instructions when using a color catcher with mixed-color laundry.”
